a2-u6-l1.nerusim.en.en: Am I disturbing you? (on the phone)

a2-u6-l1.nerusim.note.en: **rušiť** = to disturb. When it's a good time, the answer is **Nie, nerušíš, pokojne hovor.** = No, go ahead (**pokojne** = calmly, freely).
a2-u6-l1.nerusim.note.t: **rušiť** = bezovta qilmoq. Agar vaqti boʻlsa, javob: **Nie, nerušíš, pokojne hovor.** = Yoʻq, bezovta qilmayapsan, bemalol gapiraver (**pokojne** = bemalol, xotirjam).

a2-u6-l1.choice-nerusis-pokojne-hovor.qu.en: Tomáš calls: “Ahoj, Emma, tu je Tomáš. Neruším?” Emma has time. What does she say?
a2-u6-l1.choice-nerusis-pokojne-hovor.qu.t: Tomash qoʻngʻiroq qiladi: «Ahoj, Emma, tu je Tomáš. Neruším?» Emmaning vaqti bor. U nima deydi?

a2-u6-l1.choice-nerusis-pokojne-hovor.wh.en: Tomáš is a friend, so Emma uses ty: **nerušíš**, **hovor**. Nerušíte and hovorte are for someone you call vy.
a2-u6-l1.choice-nerusis-pokojne-hovor.wh.t: Tomash — doʻst, shuning uchun Emma ty (sen) ishlatadi: **nerušíš**, **hovor**. Nerušíte va hovorte — «siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odam uchun.

a2-u6-l1.nechces-ist-s-nami.en.en: Would you like to come on a trip with us?

a2-u6-l1.nechces-ist-s-nami.note.en: A friendly invitation often starts with **ne-**: Nechceš…? To someone you call vy: **Nechcete** ísť s nami?
a2-u6-l1.nechces-ist-s-nami.note.t: Samimiy taklif koʻpincha **ne-** bilan boshlanadi: Nechceš…? Oʻzbekchada ham shunday: «Biz bilan bormaysanmi?» «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Nechcete** ísť s nami?

a2-u6-l1.fill-ahoj-marek-nechces-ist.en.en: Hi, Marek! Would you like to come on a trip with us in May?
a2-u6-l1.fill-ahoj-marek-nechces-ist.en.t: Salom, Marek! May oyida biz bilan sayohatga borishni xohlamaysanmi?

a2-u6-l1.fill-ahoj-marek-nechces-ist.why.en: After **s** (with), my takes its with-form: s **nami**, like so mnou and s tebou.
a2-u6-l1.fill-ahoj-marek-nechces-ist.why.t: **s** (bilan) dan keyin my oʻzining «bilan» shaklini oladi: s **nami** (biz bilan), xuddi so mnou (men bilan) va s tebou (sen bilan) kabi.

a2-u6-l1.build-lucia-nechces-ist.prompt.en: Lucia, would you like to come to the cinema with us?
a2-u6-l1.build-lucia-nechces-ist.prompt.t: Lusiya, biz bilan kinoga borishni xohlamaysanmi?

en: You're asking Lucia, a friend (ty), so the verb ends in **-š**: **nechceš**. Nechcem means I don't want.
Going to the cinema is a set phrase you know: do **kina**.
t: Siz doʻstingiz Lusiyadan soʻrayapsiz (ty), shuning uchun feʼl **-š** bilan tugaydi: **nechceš**. Nechcem — «xohlamayman» degani.
Kinoga borish — sizga tanish turgʻun ibora: do **kina**.

a2-u6-l1.overim-si-to.note.en: **overiť si** = to check, to make sure. Like zavolám, it points to the future: Overím si to v práci. = I'll check at work.
a2-u6-l1.overim-si-to.note.t: **overiť si** = tekshirib koʻrmoq, aniqlamoq. zavolám kabi, u kelasi zamonni bildiradi: Overím si to v práci. = Ishda tekshirib koʻraman.

a2-u6-l1.premysli-si-to.note.en: **premyslieť si** = to think something over. The answer: **Premyslím si to.** = I'll think it over.
a2-u6-l1.premysli-si-to.note.t: **premyslieť si** = biror narsani oʻylab koʻrmoq. Javob: **Premyslím si to.** = Oʻylab koʻraman.

a2-u6-l1.fill-este-si-to-premyslim.en.en: I don't know. I'll think it over a bit more.

a2-u6-l1.fill-este-si-to-premyslim.why.en: Here **ja** will do the thinking, so the verb ends in **-m**: premyslím si to. Premysli tells someone else to think it over.
a2-u6-l1.fill-este-si-to-premyslim.why.t: Bu yerda **ja** (men) oʻylaydi, shuning uchun feʼl **-m** bilan tugaydi: premyslím si to. Premysli esa boshqa odamga «oʻylab koʻr» deydi.

a2-u6-l1.daj-mi-vediet.note.en: **dať vedieť** = to let someone know. The answer: **Dám ti vedieť.** = I'll let you know. To someone you call vy: **Dajte** mi vedieť.
a2-u6-l1.daj-mi-vediet.note.t: **dať vedieť** = xabar bermoq. Javob: **Dám ti vedieť.** = Senga xabar beraman. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Dajte** mi vedieť.

a2-u6-l1.build-overim-si-to-a.prompt.en: I'll check and let you know.
a2-u6-l1.build-overim-si-to-a.prompt.t: Tekshirib koʻraman va senga xabar beraman.

en: You're the one who'll let them know, so it's the ja form: **dám** ti vedieť. Daj asks someone else to.
**Ja** will check, so the verb ends in **-m**: **Overím** si to. Overíš is ty.
t: Xabarni siz berasiz, shuning uchun ja shakli: **dám** ti vedieť. Daj esa boshqa odamdan xabar berishni soʻraydi.
**Ja** (men) tekshiradi, shuning uchun feʼl **-m** bilan tugaydi: **Overím** si to. Overíš — ty shakli.

a2-u6-l1.vyhovuje-ti-to.note.en: **vyhovovať** = to suit. Like páči sa mi, the thing that suits is the subject: Sobota mi vyhovuje. = Saturday suits me. Polite: Vyhovuje **vám** to?
a2-u6-l1.vyhovuje-ti-to.note.t: **vyhovovať** = toʻgʻri kelmoq, maʼqul boʻlmoq. páči sa mi kabi, toʻgʻri keladigan narsa — ega: Sobota mi vyhovuje. = Shanba menga toʻgʻri keladi. Oʻzbekchadagi kabi, kimga toʻgʻri kelishi alohida aytiladi (mi = menga). Hurmat bilan: Vyhovuje **vám** to?

a2-u6-l1.fill-sobota-mi-vyhovuje.en.en: A trip on Saturday? Yes, Saturday suits me.
a2-u6-l1.fill-sobota-mi-vyhovuje.en.t: Shanba kuni sayohatmi? Ha, shanba menga toʻgʻri keladi.

a2-u6-l1.fill-sobota-mi-vyhovuje.why.en: The thing that suits is the subject, sobota (ona), so the verb has no ending: **vyhovuje**. Mi says who it suits, as in páči sa mi.
a2-u6-l1.fill-sobota-mi-vyhovuje.why.t: Toʻgʻri keladigan narsa — ega, sobota (ona), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz: **vyhovuje**. Mi (menga) esa kimga toʻgʻri kelishini aytadi, xuddi páči sa mi dagi kabi.

a2-u6-l1.choice-vyhovuje-ti-piatok.quest.en: Emma wants to know if Friday suits Marek. What does she ask?
a2-u6-l1.choice-vyhovuje-ti-piatok.quest.t: Emma juma kuni Marekka toʻgʻri kelish-kelmasligini bilmoqchi. U nima deb soʻraydi?

a2-u6-l1.choice-vyhovuje-ti-piatok.why.en: Piatok is the subject, the thing that suits, so the verb is **vyhovuje**; ti (to you) says who it suits.
a2-u6-l1.choice-vyhovuje-ti-piatok.why.t: Piatok — ega, toʻgʻri keladigan narsa, shuning uchun feʼl **vyhovuje**; ti (senga) kimga toʻgʻri kelishini aytadi.

a2-u6-l1.zatial.note.en: A goodbye to a friend you'll see or speak to again soon. You know **Maj sa!** too: the answer is **Aj ty!** (You too!)
a2-u6-l1.zatial.note.t: Tez orada yana koʻradigan yoki gaplashadigan doʻstga aytiladigan xayrlashuv. **Maj sa!** ni ham bilasiz: unga javob — **Aj ty!** (Sen ham!)

a2-u6-l1.choice-maj-sa-aj-ty.question.en: At the end of the call Marek says “Maj sa!”. What do you answer?
a2-u6-l1.choice-maj-sa-aj-ty.question.t: Suhbat oxirida Marek «Maj sa!» deydi. Nima deb javob berasiz?

a2-u6-l1.choice-maj-sa-aj-ty.why.en: **Maj sa** is said to a friend (ty), so the answer is **Aj ty**, with a friendly Zatiaľ. Aj vám and Dovidenia are polite, for vy.
a2-u6-l1.choice-maj-sa-aj-ty.why.t: **Maj sa** doʻstga (ty) aytiladi, shuning uchun javob — **Aj ty**, samimiy Zatiaľ bilan. Aj vám va Dovidenia — hurmat shakli, vy uchun.

en: Think it over and let me know. See you!
Think about it and let me know. See you!
Think it over and let me know. Bye for now!
Think about it and let me know. Bye for now!
t: Oʻylab koʻr va menga xabar ber. Koʻrishguncha!
Oʻylab koʻr va xabar ber. Koʻrishguncha!
Oʻylab koʻr va menga xabar ber. Hozircha xayr!
Yaxshilab oʻylab koʻr va menga xabar ber. Koʻrishguncha!

a2-u6-l1.speak-ahoj-marek-nerusim.en.en: Hi, Marek, am I disturbing you?

a2-u6-l2.titleEn.en: A bad line and a wrong number

a2-u6-l2.pocujeme-sa.note.en: Literally “Can we hear each other?” Tomáš is calling from the train: **Je tu slabý signál.** = The signal's weak here.
a2-u6-l2.pocujeme-sa.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz: «Bir-birimizni eshityapmizmi?» Tomash poyezddan qoʻngʻiroq qilyapti: **Je tu slabý signál.** = Bu yerda aloqa (signal) kuchsiz.

a2-u6-l2.nepocujem-ta-dobre.note.en: You know **Nepočujem dobre** from unit 5; ťa says who. To someone you call vy: Nepočujem **vás** dobre.
a2-u6-l2.nepocujem-ta-dobre.note.t: **Nepočujem dobre** ni 5-boʻlimdan bilasiz; ťa (seni) kimni eshitmayotganingizni aytadi. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Nepočujem **vás** dobre.

a2-u6-l2.choice-nepocujem-ta-dobre.quest.en: Tomáš: “Haló, Emma? Počujeme sa?” The line is bad. What does Emma say?
a2-u6-l2.choice-nepocujem-ta-dobre.quest.t: Tomash: «Haló, Emma? Počujeme sa?» Aloqa yomon. Emma nima deydi?

a2-u6-l2.choice-nepocujem-ta-dobre.why.en: Tomáš is a friend and the object of počuť, so it's the short object form of ty: **ťa**. Vás is for vy; ti means to you.
a2-u6-l2.choice-nepocujem-ta-dobre.why.t: Tomash — doʻst va počuť feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi (kimni?), shuning uchun ty ning qisqa toʻldiruvchi shakli: **ťa** (seni). Vás — vy uchun; ti esa «senga» degani.

a2-u6-l2.build-som-vo-vlaku.prompt.en: I'm on the train, the signal's weak here.

en: Being on the train answers “where?”: **vo** + the locative, -u after k: vo **vlaku**.
Signál is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: **slabý** signál.
t: Poyezdda boʻlish «qayerda?» savoliga javob beradi: **vo** + lokál (oʻrin-payt kelishigi), k dan keyin esa -u: vo **vlaku** (poyezdda).
Signál — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: **slabý** signál.

a2-u6-l2.prerusilo-nas.note.en: Literally “it cut us off”: nobody did it, so the verb ends in **-o**, like Nič sa nestalo.
a2-u6-l2.prerusilo-nas.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz: «(u) bizni uzib qoʻydi». Buni hech kim qilmagan, shuning uchun feʼl **-o** bilan tugaydi, xuddi Nič sa nestalo dagi kabi.

a2-u6-l2.volal-som-pred-chvilou.note.en: **chvíľa** = a moment: **pred chvíľou** = a moment ago, **o chvíľu** = in a moment.
a2-u6-l2.volal-som-pred-chvilou.note.t: **chvíľa** = lahza, bir oz vaqt: **pred chvíľou** = hozirgina, biroz oldin; **o chvíľu** = birozdan keyin, hozir.

a2-u6-l2.build-volala-som-pred.prompt.en: Emma: “I called a moment ago, but we got cut off.”
a2-u6-l2.build-volala-som-pred.prompt.t: Emma: «Hozirgina qoʻngʻiroq qildim, lekin aloqa uzilib qoldi.»

en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: **Volala** som.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: **Volala** som.

a2-u6-l2.to-bude-asi-omyl.en.en: It must be a mistake. (a wrong number)

a2-u6-l2.to-bude-asi-omyl.note.en: You know **omyl** and **asi** from Prepáčte, to je asi omyl (unit 3); on the phone it means a wrong number. Also: **Máte nesprávne číslo.** = You've got the wrong number. **Pomýlili ste sa.** = You've dialled wrong.
a2-u6-l2.to-bude-asi-omyl.note.t: **omyl** va **asi** ni Prepáčte, to je asi omyl (3-boʻlim) iborasidan bilasiz; telefonda u notoʻgʻri raqamni bildiradi. Yana: **Máte nesprávne číslo.** = Siz notoʻgʻri raqam terdingiz. **Pomýlili ste sa.** = Adashdingiz.

a2-u6-l2.choice-halo-je-to-pizzeria.ques.en: A man calls Emma's mobile: “Haló, je to pizzeria?” What does she say?
a2-u6-l2.choice-halo-je-to-pizzeria.ques.t: Bir erkak Emmaning mobil telefoniga qoʻngʻiroq qiladi: «Haló, je to pizzeria?» Emma nima deydi?

a2-u6-l2.choice-prepacte-pomylil-som-sa..en: The man says: “Prepáčte, pomýlil som sa.” What does Emma answer?
a2-u6-l2.choice-prepacte-pomylil-som-sa..t: Erkak: «Prepáčte, pomýlil som sa.» Emma nima deb javob beradi?

a2-u6-l2.fill-asi-ste-sa-pomylili.en.en: No, this isn't a pizzeria. You must have dialled wrong.
a2-u6-l2.fill-asi-ste-sa-pomylili.en.t: Yoʻq, bu pitsseriya emas. Adashgan boʻlsangiz kerak.

a2-u6-l2.fill-asi-ste-sa-pomylili.why.en: Polite **vy** always takes **-li** in the past, even for one person: ste sa **pomýlili**.
a2-u6-l2.fill-asi-ste-sa-pomylili.why.t: Hurmat shakli **vy** oʻtgan zamonda doim **-li** oladi, hatto bir kishiga gapirganda ham: ste sa **pomýlili**. Oʻzbekchadagi «adashdingiz» kabi.

a2-u6-l2.build-mate-nespravne-cislo.prom.en: You've got the wrong number. (to a stranger)

en: The caller is a stranger, so use vy: **Máte**. Máš is for a friend.
**Nesprávne** číslo is the wrong number. Správne means right.
t: Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam notanish, shuning uchun vy (siz): **Máte**. Máš — doʻst uchun.
**Nesprávne** číslo — notoʻgʻri raqam. Správne esa «toʻgʻri» degani.

a2-u6-l2.volane-cislo-je-nedostupne.en.en: The number you are calling is not available at the moment.
a2-u6-l2.volane-cislo-je-nedostupne.en.t: Siz qoʻngʻiroq qilayotgan abonent bilan hozir bogʻlanib boʻlmaydi.

a2-u6-l2.volane-cislo-je-nedostupne.note.en: A recorded message. **momentálne** = at the moment. Another one: **Linka je obsadená.** = The line is busy.
a2-u6-l2.volane-cislo-je-nedostupne.note.t: Avtomatik javob. **momentálne** = hozirda, ayni paytda. Yana biri: **Linka je obsadená.** = Liniya band.

a2-u6-l2.nechaj-mi-odkaz.note.en: Lucia's voicemail (**odkazová schránka**): Ahoj, tu je Lucia, teraz nemôžem hovoriť. Nechaj mi odkaz! **odkaz** = a message.
a2-u6-l2.nechaj-mi-odkaz.note.t: Lusiyaning ovozli pochtasi (**odkazová schránka**): Ahoj, tu je Lucia, teraz nemôžem hovoriť. Nechaj mi odkaz! **odkaz** = (qoldirilgan) xabar.

a2-u6-l2.choice-volane-cislo-je.question.en: Emma calls Lucia and hears: “Volané číslo je momentálne nedostupné.” What does it mean?
a2-u6-l2.choice-volane-cislo-je.question.t: Emma Lusiyaga qoʻngʻiroq qiladi va shuni eshitadi: «Volané číslo je momentálne nedostupné.» Bu nimani anglatadi?

en: Lucia's phone can't be reached right now.
Emma has dialled the wrong number.
t: Lusiyaning telefoni bilan hozir bogʻlanib boʻlmaydi.

a2-u6-l2.speak-pocujeme-sa-nepocujem.en.en: Can you hear me? I can't hear you well.

a2-u6-l3.stazistka.note.en: You know **stáž** (an internship) from A1. Emma je od pondelka stážistka v Tomášovej firme. = From Monday Emma is an intern at Tomáš's company.
a2-u6-l3.stazistka.note.t: **stáž** (amaliyot) soʻzini A1 dan bilasiz. Emma je od pondelka stážistka v Tomášovej firme. = Dushanbadan boshlab Emma Tomashning firmasida amaliyotchi.

a2-u6-l3.recepcia.note.en: On her first morning Emma helps Petra Bartošová **na recepcii** and answers every **telefonát** (phone call): **Recepcia, dobrý deň.**
a2-u6-l3.recepcia.note.t: Birinchi kuni ertalab Emma **na recepcii** (qabulxonada) Petra Bartoshovaga yordam beradi va har bir qoʻngʻiroqqa (**telefonát**) javob beradi: **Recepcia, dobrý deň.**

a2-u6-l3.pri-telefone-emma.note.en: How you give your name when you answer at work. You know **Tu je Emma.** for when you're the one calling.
a2-u6-l3.pri-telefone-emma.note.t: Ishda telefonga javob berganda ismingizni shunday aytasiz. **Tu je Emma.** esa oʻzingiz qoʻngʻiroq qilganingizda aytiladi.

a2-u6-l3.choice-recepcia-dobry-den.quest.en: The phone rings at reception. What does Emma say?
a2-u6-l3.choice-recepcia-dobry-den.quest.t: Qabulxonada telefon jiringlaydi. Emma nima deydi?

a2-u6-l3.choice-recepcia-dobry-den.why.en: At work you answer formally: the place, **Dobrý deň** and your name. Neruším? is what a caller asks, and Ahoj is for friends.
a2-u6-l3.choice-recepcia-dobry-den.why.t: Ishda rasmiy javob beriladi: joy nomi, **Dobrý deň** va ismingiz. Neruším? ni qoʻngʻiroq qilayotgan odam soʻraydi, Ahoj esa doʻstlar uchun.

a2-u6-l3.mozem-hovorit-s-panom.en.en: May I speak to Mr Hudák?

a2-u6-l3.mozem-hovorit-s-panom.note.en: After **s**, both words take the instrumental: s pán**om** Hudák**om**. **Pani** never changes: s pani Bartošov**ou**.
a2-u6-l3.mozem-hovorit-s-panom.note.t: **s** (bilan) dan keyin ikkala soʻz ham inštrumentál oladi — bu «bilan» maʼnosini beradigan kelishik: s pán**om** Hudák**om**. **Pani** esa hech qachon oʻzgarmaydi: s pani Bartošov**ou**.

a2-u6-l3.fill-s-pani-bartosovou.en.en: Hello, may I speak to Mrs Bartošová?
a2-u6-l3.fill-s-pani-bartosovou.en.t: Assalomu alaykum, Bartoshova xonim bilan gaplashsam boʻladimi?

a2-u6-l3.fill-s-pani-bartosovou.why.en: Bartošová is a woman, and **pani** never changes, whatever the case: s **pani** Bartošovou. Pán and pánom are for a man.
a2-u6-l3.fill-s-pani-bartosovou.why.t: Bartošová — ayol, **pani** esa qaysi kelishikda boʻlmasin oʻzgarmaydi: s **pani** Bartošovou. Pán va pánom — erkak uchun.

a2-u6-l3.fill-mozem-hovorit-s-tomasom.en.en: Excuse me, may I speak to Tomáš?

a2-u6-l3.fill-mozem-hovorit-s-tomasom.wh.en: After **s** (with), a man's name takes the instrumental, **-om**: s **Tomášom**.
a2-u6-l3.fill-mozem-hovorit-s-tomasom.wh.t: **s** (bilan) dan keyin erkak ismi inštrumentálda **-om** oladi: s **Tomášom** (Tomash bilan).

a2-u6-l3.s-kym-chcete-hovorit.en.en: Who would you like to speak to?

a2-u6-l3.s-kym-chcete-hovorit.note.en: **s kým** = with whom, the instrumental of kto. When a caller doesn't say who they are: **Prepáčte, s kým hovorím?** = Sorry, who am I speaking to?
a2-u6-l3.s-kym-chcete-hovorit.note.t: **s kým** = kim bilan, kto ning inštrumentál shakli. Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam oʻzini tanishtirmasa: **Prepáčte, s kým hovorím?** = Kechirasiz, kim bilan gaplashyapman?

a2-u6-l3.fill-prepacte-s-kym-hovorim.en.en: Sorry, who am I speaking to?

a2-u6-l3.fill-prepacte-s-kym-hovorim.why.en: After **s** (with), kto takes its instrumental form: s **kým**.
a2-u6-l3.fill-prepacte-s-kym-hovorim.why.t: **s** (bilan) dan keyin kto inštrumentál shaklini oladi: s **kým** (kim bilan).

a2-u6-l3.moment-prepojim-vas.en.en: One moment, I'll put you through.

a2-u6-l3.moment-prepojim-vas.note.en: **prepojiť** = to put through. When the person is close by: **Moment, hneď ho zavolám.** = One moment, I'll get him right away (**hneď** = right away).
a2-u6-l3.moment-prepojim-vas.note.t: **prepojiť** = (telefonda) ulamoq. Kerakli odam yaqin boʻlsa: **Moment, hneď ho zavolám.** = Bir daqiqa, hozir uni chaqiraman (**hneď** = hozir, darhol).

a2-u6-l3.pan-inzinier-pani-inzinierka.no.en: Slovaks often use titles at work: **pani doktorka**, **pán riaditeľ** (the director). Tomáš's boss (**šéf**) is pán inžinier Hudák: s pánom inžinierom Hudákom.
a2-u6-l3.pan-inzinier-pani-inzinierka.no.t: Slovaklar ishda koʻpincha unvon ishlatadi: **pani doktorka**, **pán riaditeľ** (direktor). Tomashning boshligʻi (**šéf**) — pán inžinier Hudák: s pánom inžinierom Hudákom.

a2-u6-l3.fill-s-panom-riaditelom.en.en: I'd like to speak to the director.

a2-u6-l3.fill-s-panom-riaditelom.why.en: After **s**, the title takes the instrumental too: s pán**om** riaditeľ**om**. Pani is the only word that never changes.
a2-u6-l3.fill-s-panom-riaditelom.why.t: **s** dan keyin unvon ham inštrumentál oladi: s pán**om** riaditeľ**om**. Faqat pani oʻzgarmaydi.

a2-u6-l3.choice-pani-kollarova-moment.qu.en: A caller asks for pani inžinierka Kollárová. She's at her desk. What does Emma say?
a2-u6-l3.choice-pani-kollarova-moment.qu.t: Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam muhandis Kollarova xonimni soʻrayapti. Kollarova xonim oʻz joyida. Emma nima deydi?

en: One moment, I'll get him right away.
Just a moment, I'll get him right away.
One moment, I'll call him right away.
t: Bir daqiqa, hozir unga qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.

a2-u6-l3.build-s-kym-chcete.prompt.en: Who would you like to speak to? (to a caller)

en: With **s** (with), kto takes its instrumental form: s **kým**.
A caller is a stranger, so use vy: **chcete**.
t: **s** (bilan) dan keyin kto inštrumentál shaklini oladi: s **kým**.
Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam notanish, shuning uchun vy (siz): **chcete**.

a2-u6-l3.build-mozem-hovorit-s-pani.prom.en: May I speak to Mrs Kollárová?

en: After **s**, a woman's surname takes **-ou**: s pani **Kollárovou**.
Kollárová is a woman, so it's **pani**, which never changes. Pánom is for a man.
t: **s** dan keyin ayol familiyasi **-ou** oladi: s pani **Kollárovou**.
Kollárová — ayol, shuning uchun **pani**, u esa oʻzgarmaydi. Pánom — erkak uchun.

a2-u6-l3.speak-moment-prepojim-vas.en.en: One moment, I'll put you through.

a2-u6-l4.lutujem-prave-ma-poradu.en.en: I'm sorry, he's in a meeting right now.

a2-u6-l4.lutujem-prave-ma-poradu.note.en: **Ľutujem** = I'm sorry, a polite way to say no. **práve** = right now. You know **porada** (a meeting) from A1.
a2-u6-l4.lutujem-prave-ma-poradu.note.t: **Ľutujem** = afsuski, «yoʻq» deyishning muloyim usuli. **práve** = hozir, ayni paytda. **porada** (yigʻilish) ni A1 dan bilasiz.

a2-u6-l4.momentalne-nie-je-v.en.en: He isn't in the office at the moment.

a2-u6-l4.momentalne-nie-je-v.note.en: Or: je **na obede** (at lunch), **na služobnej ceste** (on a business trip), **na dovolenke** (on holiday).
a2-u6-l4.momentalne-nie-je-v.note.t: Yoki: je **na obede** (tushlikda), **na služobnej ceste** (xizmat safarida), **na dovolenke** (taʼtilda).

en: Mr Hudák is on a business trip this week.
Mr Hudák is on holiday this week.
Mr Hudák has a meeting this week.
t: Janob Hudak bu hafta xizmat safarida.
Janob Hudakning bu hafta yigʻilishi bor.

a2-u6-l4.fill-pani-kollarova-je-dnes.en.en: Mrs Kollárová is at a conference today.

a2-u6-l4.fill-pani-kollarova-je-dnes.why.en: Being somewhere answers “where?”, so **na** takes the locative, and nouns in -ia get **-ii**: na **konferencii**.
a2-u6-l4.fill-pani-kollarova-je-dnes.why.t: Biror joyda boʻlish «qayerda?» savoliga javob beradi, shuning uchun **na** lokál talab qiladi, -ia bilan tugaydigan otlar esa **-ii** oladi: na **konferencii**.

a2-u6-l4.chcete-nechat-odkaz.en.en: Would you like to leave a message?

a2-u6-l4.chcete-nechat-odkaz.note.en: You know **nechať** (to leave) from unit 2 and **odkaz** from Lucia's voicemail: Nechaj mi odkaz.
a2-u6-l4.chcete-nechat-odkaz.note.t: **nechať** (qoldirmoq) ni 2-boʻlimdan, **odkaz** ni esa Lusiyaning ovozli pochtasidan bilasiz: Nechaj mi odkaz.

a2-u6-l4.nie-dakujem-zavolam-neskor.en.en: No, thank you, I'll call back later.

a2-u6-l4.nie-dakujem-zavolam-neskor.note.en: **neskôr** = later. Or: zavolám **o hodinu** (in an hour), **o desať minút**, **zajtra**.
a2-u6-l4.nie-dakujem-zavolam-neskor.note.t: **neskôr** = keyinroq. Yoki: zavolám **o hodinu** (bir soatdan keyin), **o desať minút** (oʻn daqiqadan keyin), **zajtra** (ertaga).

a2-u6-l4.build-zavolam-o-hodinu.prompt.en: I'll call back in an hour.

en: You're the one calling, so it's the ja form, which points to the future: **Zavolám**. Zavolaj tells someone else to call.
“In an hour” is **o** + the object form: o **hodinu**.
t: Qoʻngʻiroqni siz qilasiz, shuning uchun ja shakli, u kelasi zamonni bildiradi: **Zavolám**. Zavolaj esa boshqa odamga «qoʻngʻiroq qil» deydi.

a2-u6-l4.zavolajte-neskor-prosim.note.en: **Zavolajte** asks someone you call vy to call. The next lesson shows how these forms are made.
a2-u6-l4.zavolajte-neskor-prosim.note.t: **Zavolajte** — «siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamdan qoʻngʻiroq qilishni soʻrash. Bu shakllar qanday yasalishini keyingi dars koʻrsatadi.

a2-u6-l4.choice-zavolajte-o-desat.questi.en: Mr Hudák's meeting ends soon. What does Emma tell the caller?
a2-u6-l4.choice-zavolajte-o-desat.questi.t: Janob Hudakning yigʻilishi tez orada tugaydi. Emma qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odamga nima deydi?

a2-u6-l4.choice-zavolajte-o-desat.why.en: Emma is asking the caller (vy) to call: **Zavolajte**. Zavolám would mean Emma will call, and nechaj is for a friend.
a2-u6-l4.choice-zavolajte-o-desat.why.t: Emma qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odamdan (vy) qoʻngʻiroq qilishni soʻrayapti: **Zavolajte**. Zavolám — «Emma qoʻngʻiroq qiladi» degani boʻlardi, nechaj esa doʻst uchun.

a2-u6-l4.poviem-mu-to.note.en: **povedať** = to tell, to say: poviem, povieš, povie… (it points to the future). **mu** = (to) him, **jej** = (to) her: Poviem jej to.
a2-u6-l4.poviem-mu-to.note.t: **povedať** = aytmoq: poviem, povieš, povie… (kelasi zamonni bildiradi). **mu** = unga (erkakka), **jej** = unga (ayolga): Poviem jej to. Oʻzbekchada ikkalasi ham «unga», slovakchada esa farq bor.

a2-u6-l4.fill-poviem-jej-to.en.en: Mrs Kollárová is at lunch. I'll tell her.
a2-u6-l4.fill-poviem-jej-to.en.t: Kollarova xonim tushlikda. Unga aytib qoʻyaman.

a2-u6-l4.fill-poviem-jej-to.why.en: You tell something **to** someone, the to-whom form. Pani Kollárová is a woman, so **jej**. Ju is the object form (her), and mu is for a man.
a2-u6-l4.fill-poviem-jej-to.why.t: Biror narsani kimgadir aytasiz — «kimga?» shakli (datív, joʻnalish kelishigi). Kollarova xonim — ayol, shuning uchun **jej**. Ju — toʻldiruvchi shakli (uni, ayolni), mu esa erkak uchun.

a2-u6-l4.mozem-poprosit-este-raz.en.en: Could I have your name again, please?
a2-u6-l4.mozem-poprosit-este-raz.en.t: Ismingizni yana bir bor aytib bera olasizmi?

a2-u6-l4.mozem-poprosit-este-raz.note.en: **poprosiť** = to ask for, politely; **ešte raz** = once more. Then: **Ako sa to píše?** (How do you spell that?) and **Na aké číslo vám môže zavolať?** (What number can he call you on?)
a2-u6-l4.mozem-poprosit-este-raz.note.t: **poprosiť** = (muloyimlik bilan) soʻramoq; **ešte raz** = yana bir marta. Keyin: **Ako sa to píše?** (Bu qanday yoziladi?) va **Na aké číslo vám môže zavolať?** (U sizga qaysi raqamga qoʻngʻiroq qilishi mumkin?)

a2-u6-l4.choice-mozem-poprosit-vase-meno.en: Emma didn't catch the caller's name. What does she ask?
a2-u6-l4.choice-mozem-poprosit-vase-meno.t: Emma qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odamning ismini eshitmay qoldi. U nima deb soʻraydi?

a2-u6-l4.choice-mozem-poprosit-vase-meno.en: A caller is a stranger, so it's vy and **vaše** meno. Tvoje and ako sa voláš are for a friend.
a2-u6-l4.choice-mozem-poprosit-vase-meno.t: Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam notanish, shuning uchun vy va **vaše** meno (ismingiz). Tvoje va ako sa voláš — doʻst uchun.

a2-u6-l4.build-na-ake-cislo-vam-moze.pro.en: What number can he call you on? (to a caller)
a2-u6-l4.build-na-ake-cislo-vam-moze.pro.t: U sizga qaysi raqamga qoʻngʻiroq qilishi mumkin? (qoʻngʻiroq qilgan kishiga)

en: Číslo is neuter, so the question word matches it: **aké** číslo.
A caller is a stranger, so use vy: **vám** (to you).
t: Číslo — oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun soʻroq soʻzi unga moslashadi: **aké** číslo.
Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam notanish, shuning uchun vy: **vám** (sizga).

a2-u6-l4.build-chcete-nechat-odkaz.promp.en: Would you like to leave a message? (to a caller)

en: A caller is a stranger, so use vy: **Chcete**.
After chcete comes the infinitive, the -ť form: chcete **nechať**.
t: Qoʻngʻiroq qilgan odam notanish, shuning uchun vy: **Chcete**.
chcete dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť bilan tugaydigan shakl keladi: chcete **nechať**.

a2-u6-l4.build-pan-hudak-momentalne.prom.en: Mr Hudák isn't in the office at the moment.

en: In the office answers “where?”: v + the locative, and nouns in -ia get **-ii**: v **kancelárii**.
Being somewhere is byť, and “not” with byť is a separate word: **nie** je. Nemá means doesn't have.
t: Ofisda — «qayerda?» savoliga javob: v + lokál, -ia bilan tugaydigan otlar esa **-ii** oladi: v **kancelárii**.
Biror joyda boʻlish — byť, byť bilan inkor esa alohida soʻz: **nie** je (emas). Nemá — «unda yoʻq» degani.

a2-u6-l4.build-odkaz-pre-pana-hudaka.pro.en: Emma writes the note: “Message for Mr Hudák: Mrs Kollárová called, she'll call back at three.”
a2-u6-l4.build-odkaz-pre-pana-hudaka.pro.t: Emma yozib qoʻyadi: «Janob Hudak uchun xabar: Kollarova xonim qoʻngʻiroq qildi, soat uchda yana qoʻngʻiroq qiladi.»

en: **Pre** (for) takes the object form, and pán Hudák is a man, so both add **-a**: pre pána **Hudáka**.
Pani Kollárová is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: **volala**.
t: **Pre** (uchun) toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi, pán Hudák esa erkak, shuning uchun ikkala soʻz ham **-a** oladi: pre pána **Hudáka**.
Kollarova xonim — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: **volala**.

en: You know a few commands already: Poďte ďalej, Prepáčte, Maj sa, Zavolajte neskôr. This form is the **imperative**. To make it, take the **oni** form and drop its ending: čítaj**ú** → čítaj. What's left is the ty form: Čítaj!
For vy (a stranger or a group), add **-te**: čítaj**te**. For my, “let's”, add **-me**: čítaj**me**. Only these three persons have an imperative.
t: Bir nechta buyruqni allaqachon bilasiz: Poďte ďalej, Prepáčte, Maj sa, Zavolajte neskôr. Bu shakl — **buyruq mayli** (imperatív). Uni yasash uchun **oni** shaklini olib, qoʻshimchasini tashlang: čítaj**ú** → čítaj. Qolgani — ty (sen) shakli: Čítaj! (Oʻqi!) Oʻzbekchadagi kabi, bu feʼlning oʻzagi: oʻqi, yoz.
Vy (notanish odam yoki guruh) uchun **-te** qoʻshing: čítaj**te** (oʻqing). My uchun, yaʼni «-aylik» maʼnosida, **-me** qoʻshing: čítaj**me** (oʻqiylik). Buyruq shakli faqat shu uch shaxsda boʻladi.

a2-u6-l5.fill-tomas-zavolaj-mi.why.en: Tomáš is a friend (ty), so it's the bare stem, with no ending: **zavolaj**. Zavolajte is for vy, and zavolám means I'll call.
a2-u6-l5.fill-tomas-zavolaj-mi.why.t: Tomash — doʻst (ty), shuning uchun qoʻshimchasiz oʻzak: **zavolaj**. Zavolajte — vy uchun, zavolám esa «qoʻngʻiroq qilaman» degani.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pan-hudak-pockajte.en.en: Mr Hudák, please wait a moment.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pan-hudak-pockajte.why.en: To someone you call vy, add **-te** to the stem: počkaj → **počkajte**. Počkáte, with a long á, means you will wait.
a2-u6-l5.fill-pan-hudak-pockajte.why.t: «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga oʻzakka **-te** qoʻshing: počkaj → **počkajte**. Choʻziq á bilan počkáte esa «kutasiz» degani.

a2-u6-l5.choice-pis.question.en: Písať (to write) has the oni form píšu. What's the ty imperative?
a2-u6-l5.choice-pis.question.t: Písať (yozmoq) feʼlining oni shakli — píšu. Ty uchun buyruq shakli qanday?

a2-u6-l5.choice-pis.why.en: Drop the ending of píš**u** and you have the ty form: **Píš!** Píšte is for vy; píše means he or she writes.
a2-u6-l5.choice-pis.why.t: píš**u** ning qoʻshimchasini tashlasangiz, ty shakli qoladi: **Píš!** (Yoz!) Píšte — vy uchun; píše esa «u yozadi» degani.

en: To a stranger, the vy form: hovor + **-te** = **Hovorte**. Hovor is for a friend.
“Slowly” is the adverb **pomaly**; pomalý is the adjective, as in a slow train.
t: Notanish odamga — vy shakli: hovor + **-te** = **Hovorte**. Hovor — doʻst uchun.
«Sekin» — ravish **pomaly**; pomalý esa sifat, masalan pomalý vlak (sekin poyezd).

a2-u6-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-napiste.en.en: Emma and Lucia, write to me tomorrow!
a2-u6-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-napiste.en.t: Emma va Lusiya, ertaga menga yozinglar!

a2-u6-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-napiste.why.en: Two people are vy, so add **-te**: napíš → **napíšte**. Napíš is for one friend, and napíšeme means we'll write.
a2-u6-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-napiste.why.t: Ikki kishi — vy, shuning uchun **-te** qoʻshing: napíš → **napíšte**. Napíš — bitta doʻst uchun, napíšeme esa «yozamiz» degani.

a2-u6-l5.fill-mame-cas-dajme.en.en: We've got time. Let's have a coffee!

a2-u6-l5.fill-mame-cas-dajme.why.en: “Let's” is the my form, the stem + **-me**: daj → **Dajme** si kávu. Dajte and daj tell other people to have one.
a2-u6-l5.fill-mame-cas-dajme.why.t: «-aylik» — my shakli, oʻzak + **-me**: daj → **Dajme** si kávu. Dajte va daj esa boshqalarga «iching / ich» deydi.

en: In a command the verb comes first, and small words like **mi**, **mu**, **sa** and **si** follow it straight away: **Daj mi** vedieť. **Zavolaj mu.** **Dajte si** kávu.
With prosím, both orders are polite: Počkajte, prosím. Prosím, počkajte.
t: Buyruqda feʼl birinchi keladi, **mi**, **mu**, **sa** va **si** kabi kichik soʻzlar esa darhol undan keyin turadi: **Daj mi** vedieť. **Zavolaj mu.** **Dajte si** kávu.
prosím bilan ikkala tartib ham muloyim: Počkajte, prosím. Prosím, počkajte.

a2-u6-l5.choice-daj-mi-vediet.why.en: The command comes first, and the small word **mi** goes right after it: Daj **mi** vedieť.
a2-u6-l5.choice-daj-mi-vediet.why.t: Buyruq birinchi keladi, kichik **mi** soʻzi esa darhol undan keyin: Daj **mi** vedieť.

a2-u6-l5.build-pockaj-ma-pred.prompt.en: Wait for me in front of the office! (to a friend)

en: You're telling a friend to wait: the ty form **Počkaj**. Počkám means I'll wait.
**Pred** (in front of) takes the instrumental: pred **kanceláriou**.
t: Doʻstingizga kutishni aytyapsiz: ty shakli **Počkaj**. Počkám — «kutaman» degani.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-bartosova-zatelefonuj.en: Mrs Bartošová, please phone me tomorrow morning.
a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-bartosova-zatelefonuj.t: Bartoshova xonim, iltimos, ertaga ertalab menga qoʻngʻiroq qiling.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-bartosova-zatelefonuj.en: Zatelefonovať (= zavolať) goes like pracovať: zatelefonujú → zatelefonuj, and for vy add **-te**: **zatelefonujte**. Zatelefonujete means you will phone.
a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-bartosova-zatelefonuj.t: Zatelefonovať (= zavolať) pracovať kabi tuslanadi: zatelefonujú → zatelefonuj, vy uchun esa **-te** qoʻshiladi: **zatelefonujte**. Zatelefonujete — «qoʻngʻiroq qilasiz» degani.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-kollarova-dajte-si.en.en: Mrs Kollárová, please have a coffee.

a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-kollarova-dajte-si.wh.en: To someone you call vy: daj + **-te** = **dajte**, and si comes right after it. Dáte means you will have.
a2-u6-l5.fill-pani-kollarova-dajte-si.wh.t: «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: daj + **-te** = **dajte**, si esa darhol undan keyin keladi. Dáte — «ichasiz (olasiz)» degani.

en: Write me an e-mail and call me tomorrow.
Send me an e-mail and call me tomorrow.
t: Menga elektron xat yozing va ertaga qoʻngʻiroq qiling.
Menga elektron xat yozing va ertaga menga qoʻngʻiroq qiling.
Menga elektron xat yuboring va ertaga qoʻngʻiroq qiling.
Menga xat yozing va ertaga qoʻngʻiroq qiling.

en: To pass on what someone said, use **povedať** (to say, to tell) or **napísať**, then a comma and **že** (that): Pán Hudák povedal, **že** zavolá neskôr.

Change the person, as in English: “Zavolám.” → povedal, že zavol**á**. But keep the tense: Slovak passes it on as it was said. “Mám poradu.” → Povedala, že **má** poradu. = She said she had a meeting.
t: Kimdir aytgan gapni yetkazish uchun **povedať** (aytmoq) yoki **napísať** (yozmoq), keyin vergul va **že** (…ki, …ligini) ishlating: Pán Hudák povedal, **že** zavolá neskôr. = Janob Hudak keyinroq qoʻngʻiroq qilishini aytdi.

Shaxs oʻzgaradi: «Zavolám.» → povedal, že zavol**á**. Zamon esa oʻzgarmaydi, gap qanday aytilgan boʻlsa, shunday yetkaziladi: «Mám poradu.» → Povedala, že **má** poradu. = U yigʻilishi borligini aytdi. Oʻzbekchada ham «bor» hozirgi zamonda qoladi.

en: Petra said Mr Hudák was at lunch.
Tomáš wrote that he'd come tomorrow.
t: Petra janob Hudak tushlikda ekanini aytdi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-petra-povedala-ze.en.en: Petra said Mr Hudák had a meeting.
a2-u6-l6.fill-petra-povedala-ze.en.t: Petra janob Hudakning yigʻilishi borligini aytdi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-petra-povedala-ze.why.en: Passing on a statement takes **že** (that), after a comma. Kde and kedy would pass on a question.
a2-u6-l6.fill-petra-povedala-ze.why.t: Darak gapni yetkazish uchun vergul va **že** (…ki) kerak. Kde va kedy esa savolni yetkazadi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-tomas-povedal-ze-zavola.en.en: Tomáš: “I'll call in an hour.” Tomáš said he'd call in an hour.
a2-u6-l6.fill-tomas-povedal-ze-zavola.en.t: Tomash: «Bir soatdan keyin qoʻngʻiroq qilaman.» Tomash bir soatdan keyin qoʻngʻiroq qilishini aytdi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-tomas-povedal-ze-zavola.wh.en: Now Tomáš is on, so the person changes: zavolám → **zavolá**. The tense stays as he said it, so not zavolal.
a2-u6-l6.fill-tomas-povedal-ze-zavola.wh.t: Endi Tomash — on (u), shuning uchun shaxs oʻzgaradi: zavolám → **zavolá**. Zamon esa u aytgandek qoladi, shuning uchun zavolal emas.

en: Lucia asked if you were ill.
Lucia wrote that she was ill.
Lucia wrote that you were ill.

a2-u6-l6.choice-lucia-napisala-ze.why.en: **Že** passes on a statement, and **je** chorá is she is ill. Slovak keeps the tense where English says “was”.
a2-u6-l6.choice-lucia-napisala-ze.why.t: **Že** darak gapni yetkazadi, **je** chorá esa «u kasal» degani. Slovak tilida zamon oʻzgarmaydi, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «kasal ekanini yozdi» kabi.

a2-u6-l6.build-povedal-ze-ma.prompt.en: He said he had a meeting.

en: Slovak keeps the tense of what was said: “Mám poradu.” → že **má** poradu. Only English says had.
He is on now, so the person changes: mám → **má**.
t: Slovak tilida aytilgan gapning zamoni saqlanadi: «Mám poradu.» → že **má** poradu, oʻzbekchadagi «yigʻilishi bor» kabi.
Endi u haqida gapiryapsiz (on), shuning uchun shaxs oʻzgaradi: mám → **má**.

a2-u6-l6.grammar-reported-ci.title.en: Passing on a question: či, kde, kedy

en: A question with a question word keeps it: “Kedy prídeš?” → Pýtala sa, **kedy** prídeš.
A yes-or-no question takes **či** (whether, if): “Máš čas?” → Pýtal sa, **či** máš čas. **pýtať sa**, **opýtať sa** = to ask, with the person in the genitive: opýtať sa **Petry**.
t: Soʻroq soʻzli savolda soʻroq soʻzi saqlanadi: «Kedy prídeš?» → Pýtala sa, **kedy** prídeš. = Qachon kelishingni soʻradi.

«Ha» yoki «yoʻq» deb javob beriladigan savol **či** (…-mi, …-mi yoʻqmi) bilan yetkaziladi: «Máš čas?» → Pýtal sa, **či** máš čas. = Vaqting bor-yoʻqligini soʻradi. **pýtať sa**, **opýtať sa** = soʻramoq; kimdan soʻralsa, u genitívda (qaratqich kelishigi) boʻladi: opýtať sa **Petry** (Petradan soʻramoq).

en: Opýtala sa, **či** je Tomáš v práci.
t: Opýtala sa, **či** je Tomáš v práci.

en: Mrs Kollárová asked if you were free tomorrow.
He asked me where the reception was.
t: Kollarova xonim ertaga vaqting bor-yoʻqligini soʻradi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-pytala-sa-ci-mas.en.en: “Are you free on Friday?” Lucia asked if you were free on Friday.
a2-u6-l6.fill-pytala-sa-ci-mas.en.t: «Juma kuni vaqting bormi?» Lusiya juma kuni vaqting bor-yoʻqligini soʻradi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-pytala-sa-ci-mas.why.en: Lucia asked a yes-or-no question, and that's passed on with **či** (whether). Že is for statements.
a2-u6-l6.fill-pytala-sa-ci-mas.why.t: Lusiya «ha / yoʻq» savolini berdi, bunday savol esa **či** bilan yetkaziladi. Že — darak gaplar uchun.

a2-u6-l6.fill-pytal-sa-kedy-prides.en.en: “When are you coming to the office?” He asked when you were coming to the office.
a2-u6-l6.fill-pytal-sa-kedy-prides.en.t: «Ofisga qachon kelasan?» U ofisga qachon kelishingni soʻradi.

a2-u6-l6.fill-pytal-sa-kedy-prides.why.en: The question word stays: **kedy**. Či is only for yes-or-no questions.
a2-u6-l6.fill-pytal-sa-kedy-prides.why.t: Soʻroq soʻzi saqlanadi: **kedy** (qachon). Či faqat «ha / yoʻq» savollari uchun.

a2-u6-l6.choice-pan-hudak-sa-pytal.quest.en: Mr Hudák asked Emma: “Kde je Tomáš?” How does Emma pass it on to Tomáš?
a2-u6-l6.choice-pan-hudak-sa-pytal.quest.t: Janob Hudak Emmadan soʻradi: «Kde je Tomáš?» Emma buni Tomashga qanday yetkazadi?

a2-u6-l6.choice-pan-hudak-sa-pytal.why.en: Emma is talking to Tomáš, so he becomes ty: kde je → kde **si**. The question word kde stays.
a2-u6-l6.choice-pan-hudak-sa-pytal.why.t: Emma Tomashning oʻziga gapiryapti, shuning uchun u ty (sen) boʻladi: kde je → kde **si**. Kde soʻroq soʻzi saqlanadi.

a2-u6-l6.build-pytala-sa-ci-si.prompt.en: She asked if you were at home. (to a friend)

en: A yes-or-no question is passed on with **či**; že is for statements.
Slovak keeps the tense of the question, “Si doma?”: či **si** doma. Only English says were.
t: «Ha / yoʻq» savoli **či** bilan yetkaziladi; že — darak gaplar uchun.
Slovak tilida savolning zamoni saqlanadi («Si doma?»): či **si** doma, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «uydamisan» kabi.

a2-u6-l6.choice-mam-nejaky-odkaz.questio.en: Tomáš calls from home: “Mám nejaký odkaz?” (Are there any messages for me?) Which answer is right?
a2-u6-l6.choice-mam-nejaky-odkaz.questio.t: Tomash uydan qoʻngʻiroq qiladi: «Mám nejaký odkaz?» (Menga biror xabar bormi?) Qaysi javob toʻgʻri?

a2-u6-l6.choice-mam-nejaky-odkaz.why.en: A statement is passed on with **povedala, že**. Či goes with a question: pýtala sa, či…
a2-u6-l6.choice-mam-nejaky-odkaz.why.t: Darak gap **povedala, že** bilan yetkaziladi. Či esa savol bilan keladi: pýtala sa, či…

en: Tomáš wrote that he'd come tomorrow.
Tomáš wrote that he would come tomorrow.
Tomáš wrote that he'll come tomorrow.
Tomáš wrote that he will come tomorrow.

a2-u6-l6.fill-opytala-sa-ma.en.en: She asked Petra where the reception was.

a2-u6-l6.fill-opytala-sa-ma.why.en: **Opýtať sa** takes the genitive, so Petra changes -a to **-y**: opýtala sa **Petry**. Petru is the object form.
a2-u6-l6.fill-opytala-sa-ma.why.t: **Opýtať sa** genitív talab qiladi (oʻzbekchada «Petradan»), shuning uchun Petra -a ni **-y** ga almashtiradi: opýtala sa **Petry**. Petru — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

a2-u6-l6.speak-povedal-ze-zavola.en.en: He said he'd call back later.

a2-u6-l7.grammar-reported-aby.title.en: Passing on a request: aby + the past form
a2-u6-l7.grammar-reported-aby.title.t: Iltimosni yetkazish: aby + oʻtgan zamon shakli

en: A request or an order is passed on with **aby** (to, so that). After aby comes the **past form** (-l, -la, -li), even when the request is about later: “Zavolaj mi!” → Povedala, **aby** si jej **zavolal**.
Aby takes som, si, sme and ste, just like the past tense: aby **som**, aby **si**. For on, ona and oni, aby stands alone: Povedzte mu, prosím, **aby** mi **zavolal**. (Povedzte = tell, to vy.)
t: Iltimos yoki buyruq **aby** (…sin deb, …ishini) bilan yetkaziladi. aby dan keyin **oʻtgan zamon shakli** (-l, -la, -li) keladi, hatto iltimos kelajak haqida boʻlsa ham: «Zavolaj mi!» → Povedala, **aby** si jej **zavolal**. = U sendan oʻziga qoʻngʻiroq qilishingni soʻradi.

aby oʻtgan zamondagi kabi som, si, sme va ste ni oladi: aby **som**, aby **si**. on, ona va oni bilan aby yolgʻiz turadi: Povedzte mu, prosím, **aby** mi **zavolal**. = Iltimos, unga ayting, menga qoʻngʻiroq qilsin. (Povedzte = ayting, vy uchun.)

en: Please tell him to call me.
Mr Hudák wants us to come at nine.
Petra asked me to call Mrs Kollárová.
t: Iltimos, unga ayting, menga qoʻngʻiroq qilsin.
Janob Hudak soat toʻqqizda kelishimizni xohlaydi.
Petra mendan Kollarova xonimga qoʻngʻiroq qilishimni soʻradi.

a2-u6-l7.fill-povedzte-jej-aby.en.en: Please tell her to call me tomorrow.
a2-u6-l7.fill-povedzte-jej-aby.en.t: Iltimos, unga ayting, ertaga menga qoʻngʻiroq qilsin.

a2-u6-l7.fill-povedzte-jej-aby.why.en: After **aby** comes the past form, and she is a woman: aby mi **zavolala**. Zavolá would follow že.
a2-u6-l7.fill-povedzte-jej-aby.why.t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli keladi, u esa ayol: aby mi **zavolala**. Zavolá že dan keyin keladi.

a2-u6-l7.fill-petra-mi-povedala-aby.en.en: Emma: “Petra told me to wait here.”
a2-u6-l7.fill-petra-mi-povedala-aby.en.t: Emma: «Petra menga shu yerda kutib turishimni aytdi.»

a2-u6-l7.fill-petra-mi-povedala-aby.why.en: After **aby**, the past form, and Emma is a woman: aby som **počkala**.
a2-u6-l7.fill-petra-mi-povedala-aby.why.t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli, Emma esa ayol: aby som **počkala**.

a2-u6-l7.fill-pan-hudak-povedal-aby-ste..en: Mr Hudák told you (all) to write him an e-mail.
a2-u6-l7.fill-pan-hudak-povedal-aby-ste..t: Janob Hudak sizlarga oʻziga elektron xat yozishingizni aytdi.

a2-u6-l7.fill-pan-hudak-povedal-aby-ste..en: For **vy**, aby takes **ste**: aby **ste** mu napísali. Si and som don't go with -li.
a2-u6-l7.fill-pan-hudak-povedal-aby-ste..t: **vy** uchun aby **ste** ni oladi: aby **ste** mu napísali. Si va som -li bilan kelmaydi.

a2-u6-l7.build-povedzte-mu-prosim.prompt.en: Please tell him to call me. (to a stranger)
a2-u6-l7.build-povedzte-mu-prosim.prompt.t: Iltimos, unga (erkakka) ayting, menga qoʻngʻiroq qilsin. (notanish odamga)

en: After **aby**, the past form: aby mi **zavolal**. Zavolá goes after že.
Him, the one you tell, is **mu**; jej is for a woman.
t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli: aby mi **zavolal**. Zavolá že dan keyin keladi.
Aytiladigan odam erkak boʻlsa, «unga» — **mu**; jej — ayol uchun.

en: After **aby**, the past form: aby sme **počkali**. Počkáme means we'll wait.
Wanting someone to do something takes **aby**; že passes on a fact.
t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli: aby sme **počkali**. Počkáme — «kutamiz» degani.
Kimdir biror ish qilishini xohlash — **aby**; že esa faktni yetkazadi.

en: **Že** passes on a fact, in its own tense: Tomáš povedal, **že** počká. = Tomáš said he would wait.
**Aby** passes on a request, always with the past form: Tomáš povedal, **aby** sme počkali. = Tomáš told us to wait.
t: **Že** faktni oʻz zamonida yetkazadi: Tomáš povedal, **že** počká. = Tomash kutishini aytdi.
**Aby** iltimosni yetkazadi, doim oʻtgan zamon shakli bilan: Tomáš povedal, **aby** sme počkali. = Tomash bizga kutib turishimizni aytdi.

en: Lucia wrote that she'd come later.
Lucia wrote asking us to wait for her.
t: Lusiya oʻzini kutib turishimizni soʻrab yozdi.

a2-u6-l7.choice-tomas-povedal-ze-pocka.q.en: Tomáš said he would wait. Which sentence says that?
a2-u6-l7.choice-tomas-povedal-ze-pocka.q.t: Tomash kutishini aytdi. Qaysi gap shuni bildiradi?

a2-u6-l7.choice-tomas-povedal-ze-pocka.w.en: It's a fact about Tomáš, so **že** + počká. Aby počkal would mean he told someone else to wait.
a2-u6-l7.choice-tomas-povedal-ze-pocka.w.t: Bu Tomash haqidagi fakt, shuning uchun **že** + počká. Aby počkal esa «u boshqa odamga kutib turishni aytdi» degani boʻlardi.

a2-u6-l7.choice-lucia-mi-povedala-aby.qu.en: Lucia asked Emma to write to her. How does Emma say it?
a2-u6-l7.choice-lucia-mi-povedala-aby.qu.t: Lusiya Emmadan oʻziga yozishini soʻradi. Emma buni qanday aytadi?

a2-u6-l7.choice-lucia-mi-povedala-aby.wh.en: A request: **aby** + the past form, and Emma is a woman: aby som jej **napísala**. Že jej napíšem would mean Emma promised to write.
a2-u6-l7.choice-lucia-mi-povedala-aby.wh.t: Bu iltimos: **aby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli, Emma esa ayol: aby som jej **napísala**. Že jej napíšem esa «Emma yozishga vaʼda berdi» degani boʻlardi.

a2-u6-l7.build-lucia-ma-poprosila.prompt.en: Emma: “Lucia asked me to buy bread.”
a2-u6-l7.build-lucia-ma-poprosila.prompt.t: Emma: «Lusiya mendan non sotib olishimni soʻradi.»

en: After **aby**, the past form, and Emma is a woman: aby som **kúpila**.
It's a request, so **aby**; že passes on a fact.
t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli, Emma esa ayol: aby som **kúpila**.
Bu iltimos, shuning uchun **aby**; že faktni yetkazadi.

en: Mrs Kollárová told you to call her.
Mrs Kollárová said you should call her.
Mrs Kollárová asked you to call her.
t: Kollarova xonim oʻziga qoʻngʻiroq qilishingni aytdi.
Kollarova xonim sendan oʻziga qoʻngʻiroq qilishingni soʻradi.
Kollarova xonim senga oʻziga qoʻngʻiroq qilishingni aytdi.
Kollarova xonim unga qoʻngʻiroq qilishingni aytdi.

a2-u6-l7.fill-mama-chce-aby.en.en: Mum wants me to call her on Sunday.
a2-u6-l7.fill-mama-chce-aby.en.t: Oyim yakshanba kuni oʻziga qoʻngʻiroq qilishimni xohlaydi.

a2-u6-l7.fill-mama-chce-aby.why.en: Wanting someone else to do something takes **aby** + the past form: chce, **aby** som zavolala.
a2-u6-l7.fill-mama-chce-aby.why.t: Boshqa odam biror ish qilishini xohlash — **aby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli: chce, **aby** som zavolala.

a2-u6-l8.mila-lucia.note.en: You saw **Milá Emma** in Lucia's e-mail in unit 3. To a man: **Milý Tomáš,** to a group of friends: **Milí kamaráti,** or simply **Ahoj, Lucia!**
a2-u6-l8.mila-lucia.note.t: **Milá Emma** ni 3-boʻlimda Lusiyaning elektron xatida koʻrgansiz. Erkakka: **Milý Tomáš,** bir guruh doʻstlarga: **Milí kamaráti,** yoki shunchaki **Ahoj, Lucia!**

a2-u6-l8.choice-mily-tomas.question.en: Emma is writing to Tomáš. How does she start?
a2-u6-l8.choice-mily-tomas.question.t: Emma Tomashga xat yozyapti. U xatni qanday boshlaydi?

a2-u6-l8.choice-mily-tomas.why.en: **Milý** is an adjective, so it matches the person: milý for a man, milá for a woman: Milý Tomáš, Milá Lucia.
a2-u6-l8.choice-mily-tomas.why.t: **Milý** — sifat, shuning uchun u odamga moslashadi: erkakka milý, ayolga milá: Milý Tomáš, Milá Lucia. Oʻzbekchada «aziz» oʻzgarmaydi, slovakchada esa jins muhim.

a2-u6-l8.navrh.note.en: Mám pre vás **návrh**: výlet v máji! = I've got a suggestion for you: a trip in May! **navrhnúť** = to suggest; **trasa** = the route of a trip.
a2-u6-l8.navrh.note.t: Mám pre vás **návrh**: výlet v máji! = Sizlarga taklifim bor: may oyida sayohat! **navrhnúť** = taklif qilmoq; **trasa** = sayohat yoʻnalishi (marshrut).

a2-u6-l8.fill-ahoj-marek-mam-pre.en.en: Hi, Marek! I've got a suggestion for you.
a2-u6-l8.fill-ahoj-marek-mam-pre.en.t: Salom, Marek! Senga bir taklifim bor.

a2-u6-l8.fill-ahoj-marek-mam-pre.why.en: After **pre** (for), pronouns take their long forms: pre **teba**.
a2-u6-l8.fill-ahoj-marek-mam-pre.why.t: **pre** (uchun) dan keyin olmoshlar uzun shaklini oladi: pre **teba** (sen uchun).

a2-u6-l8.fill-mili-kamarati.en.en: Dear friends, I've got a suggestion for you.
a2-u6-l8.fill-mili-kamarati.en.t: Aziz doʻstlar, sizlarga bir taklifim bor.

a2-u6-l8.fill-mili-kamarati.why.en: Kamaráti is a group with men in it, so the adjective takes the men's plural, **-í**: **Milí** kamaráti.
a2-u6-l8.fill-mili-kamarati.why.t: Kamaráti — ichida erkaklar bor guruh, shuning uchun sifat erkaklar koʻplik qoʻshimchasi **-í** ni oladi: **Milí** kamaráti.

a2-u6-l8.dakujem-ti-za-mail.note.en: In letters and e-mails, many Slovaks write **Ty**, **Ti**, **Teba**, **Vy**, **Vám** and **Vás** with a capital letter, to be polite.
a2-u6-l8.dakujem-ti-za-mail.note.t: Xat va elektron xatlarda koʻp slovaklar hurmat belgisi sifatida **Ty**, **Ti**, **Teba**, **Vy**, **Vám** va **Vás** ni bosh harf bilan yozadi.

a2-u6-l8.cim-skor.note.en: **Napíš mi čím skôr.** = Write back as soon as possible. Or: **Ozvi sa!** = Get in touch!
a2-u6-l8.cim-skor.note.t: **Napíš mi čím skôr.** = Imkon qadar tezroq javob yoz. Yoki: **Ozvi sa!** = Xabar ber! (Bogʻlan!)

a2-u6-l8.build-napis-mi-cim-skor.prompt.en: Write back as soon as possible! (to a friend)

en: You're asking a friend to write: the command **Napíš**. Napíšem means I'll write.
**Čím skôr** = as soon as possible. Neskôr means later.
t: Siz doʻstingizdan yozishni soʻrayapsiz: buyruq **Napíš**. Napíšem — «yozaman» degani.
**Čím skôr** = imkon qadar tezroq. Neskôr — «keyinroq» degani.

a2-u6-l8.kontakt.note.en: **Dám ti kontakt na penzión.** = I'll give you the guesthouse's contact details. **penzión** = a guesthouse.
a2-u6-l8.kontakt.note.t: **Dám ti kontakt na penzión.** = Senga mehmon uyining kontaktini beraman. **penzión** = mehmon uyi (kichik mehmonxona).

a2-u6-l8.build-dakujem-ti-za-pozvanie.pr.en: Thank you for the invitation to the party. (in an e-mail to a friend)
a2-u6-l8.build-dakujem-ti-za-pozvanie.pr.t: Bazmga taklif uchun rahmat. (doʻstga elektron xatda)

en: An invitation **to** the party: na + the object form, **oslavu**. Na oslave means at the party.
You thank **za** + the object form, and pozvanie is neuter, so it doesn't change: za **pozvanie**.
t: Bazmga (**na**) taklif: na + toʻldiruvchi shakli, **oslavu**. Na oslave — «bazmda» degani.
Minnatdorchilik **za** + toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan bildiriladi, pozvanie esa oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: za **pozvanie**.

a2-u6-l8.build-dam-ti-kontakt.prompt.en: I'll give you the guesthouse's contact details.

en: You'll be the one giving it: the ja form **Dám**. Daj asks someone else to give.
Kontakt **na** someone or something takes the object form: na **penzión**. Penzióne is the locative (in the guesthouse).
t: Kontaktni siz berasiz: ja shakli **Dám**. Daj esa boshqa odamdan berishni soʻraydi.
Kimningdir yoki nimaningdir kontakti — **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli: na **penzión**. Penzióne — lokál (mehmon uyida).

a2-u6-l8.pozdravuj-mareka.note.en: Like **Pozdrav Luciu!** (unit 5), from **pozdravovať**; both are common. Many e-mails to friends end with **Pozdravujem** (Best wishes) and your name.
a2-u6-l8.pozdravuj-mareka.note.t: **Pozdrav Luciu!** (5-boʻlim) kabi, faqat **pozdravovať** feʼlidan; ikkalasi ham koʻp ishlatiladi. Doʻstlarga yozilgan koʻp elektron xatlar **Pozdravujem** (Salom bilan) va ismingiz bilan tugaydi.

a2-u6-l8.maj-sa-dobre.note.en: More friendly endings: **Pekný deň!** (Have a nice day!) Then sign: **Tvoja Emma** (a woman), **Tvoj Tomáš** (a man).
a2-u6-l8.maj-sa-dobre.note.t: Yana samimiy yakunlar: **Pekný deň!** (Kuning yaxshi oʻtsin!) Keyin imzo: **Tvoja Emma** (ayol), **Tvoj Tomáš** (erkak).

a2-u6-l8.choice-tvoj-tomas.question.en: How does Tomáš sign his e-mail to Emma?
a2-u6-l8.choice-tvoj-tomas.question.t: Tomash Emmaga yozgan xatiga qanday imzo qoʻyadi?

a2-u6-l8.choice-tvoj-tomas.why.en: **Tvoj** matches the writer: Tomáš is a man, so tvoj. Emma signs **Tvoja** Emma.
a2-u6-l8.choice-tvoj-tomas.why.t: **Tvoj** yozuvchiga moslashadi: Tomash — erkak, shuning uchun tvoj. Emma esa **Tvoja** Emma deb imzo qoʻyadi.

a2-u6-l8.build-pozdravuj-tomasa.prompt.en: Say hi to Tomáš! Take care!

en: Tomáš is the one you greet, the object, so he adds **-a**: Pozdravuj **Tomáša**.
To one friend: **Maj** sa dobre. Majte sa is for vy.
t: Tomash — siz salom aytayotgan odam, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun **-a** oladi: Pozdravuj **Tomáša**.
Bitta doʻstga: **Maj** sa dobre. Majte sa — vy uchun.

a2-u6-l8.choice-luciina-odpoved.question.en: Lucia's answer. Why didn't she write sooner?
a2-u6-l8.choice-luciina-odpoved.question.t: Lusiyaning javobi. Nega u avvalroq yozmadi?

en: She was away on a trip.

a2-u6-l8.build-prepac-ze-som-ti.prompt.en: Emma ends her e-mail: “Sorry I didn't write sooner. Best wishes, Emma”
a2-u6-l8.build-prepac-ze-som-ti.prompt.t: Emma xatini shunday tugatadi: «Avvalroq yozmaganim uchun kechir. Salom bilan, Emma»

en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: som Ti **nenapísala**.
Sooner is **skôr**, as in čím skôr. Neskôr means later.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: som Ti **nenapísala**.
«Avvalroq» — **skôr**, xuddi čím skôr dagi kabi. Neskôr — «keyinroq» degani.

a2-u6-l8.speak-mam-pre-teba-navrh.en.en: I've got a suggestion for you.

a2-u6-l9.vazena-pani-sokolova.note.en: How a formal letter or e-mail starts. To a man: **Vážený pán** Hudák, To someone whose name you don't know: **Dobrý deň,**
a2-u6-l9.vazena-pani-sokolova.note.t: Rasmiy xat yoki elektron xat shunday boshlanadi. Erkakka: **Vážený pán** Hudák, Ismini bilmagan odamga: **Dobrý deň,**

a2-u6-l9.choice-vazeny-pan-hudak.questio.en: Emma writes a formal e-mail to pán Hudák. How does she start?
a2-u6-l9.choice-vazeny-pan-hudak.questio.t: Emma janob Hudakka rasmiy elektron xat yozyapti. U qanday boshlaydi?

a2-u6-l9.choice-vazeny-pan-hudak.why.en: **Vážený** is an adjective, so it matches a man: vážený pán. Milý is for friends, with their first name.
a2-u6-l9.choice-vazeny-pan-hudak.why.t: **Vážený** — sifat, shuning uchun erkakka moslashadi: vážený pán. Milý — doʻstlar uchun, ularning ismi bilan.

a2-u6-l9.ubytovanie.note.en: Emma books the trip's **ubytovanie v penzióne** (rooms in a guesthouse) **na meno** Šimková, in Lucia's name. **s raňajkami** = with breakfast; **cena** = the price.
a2-u6-l9.ubytovanie.note.t: Emma sayohat uchun mehmon uyidan joy (**ubytovanie v penzióne**) band qiladi, **na meno** Šimková — Lusiyaning nomiga. **s raňajkami** = nonushta bilan; **cena** = narx.

a2-u6-l9.volna-izba.note.en: **Máte voľné izby?** = Have you got any rooms free? A **dvojposteľová** izba is a double room, a **jednoposteľová** a single; **rezervovať** = to book.
a2-u6-l9.volna-izba.note.t: **Máte voľné izby?** = Boʻsh xonalaringiz bormi? **Dvojposteľová** izba — ikki kishilik xona, **jednoposteľová** — bir kishilik; **rezervovať** = band qilmoq.

a2-u6-l9.fill-chcela-by-som-sa-opytat.en.en: I'd like to ask whether you have any rooms free.

a2-u6-l9.fill-chcela-by-som-sa-opytat.wh.en: Izby is plural here, and plural things take **-é**: **voľné** izby.
a2-u6-l9.fill-chcela-by-som-sa-opytat.wh.t: Bu yerda izby koʻplikda, koʻplikdagi narsalar esa **-é** oladi: **voľné** izby.

a2-u6-l9.od-piatku-do-pondelka.note.en: **Od … do** + the genitive, as in unit 5: od soboty do nedele, od 15. do 17. mája.
a2-u6-l9.od-piatku-do-pondelka.note.t: **Od … do** (…dan …gacha) + genitív (qaratqich kelishigi), 5-boʻlimdagi kabi: od soboty do nedele (shanbadan yakshanbagacha), od 15. do 17. mája.

a2-u6-l9.build-mate-volnu-izbu.prompt.en: Have you got a room free from Friday to Monday?

en: The room is what you're asking for, the object, so -á becomes **-ú**: **voľnú** izbu.
**Do** (until) takes the genitive: do **pondelka**, like od piatku.
t: Xona — siz soʻrayotgan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -á oʻrniga **-ú**: **voľnú** izbu.
**Do** (…gacha) genitív talab qiladi: do **pondelka**, xuddi od piatku kabi.

a2-u6-l9.dakujem-za-odpoved.note.en: You know **odpoveď** from otázka a odpoveď (unit 1); it's feminine. **odpovedať** = to reply: Pani Sokolová mi odpovedala.
a2-u6-l9.dakujem-za-odpoved.note.t: **odpoveď** ni otázka a odpoveď (savol va javob, 1-boʻlim) dan bilasiz; u ayol jinsida. **odpovedať** = javob bermoq: Pani Sokolová mi odpovedala. = Sokolova xonim menga javob berdi.

a2-u6-l9.s-pozdravom.note.en: The end of a formal letter or e-mail, with your name on the next line. Friends write **Pozdravujem** or **Maj sa!**
a2-u6-l9.s-pozdravom.note.t: Rasmiy xat yoki elektron xatning yakuni, keyingi qatorda esa ismingiz. Doʻstlar **Pozdravujem** yoki **Maj sa!** deb yozadi.

a2-u6-l9.choice-s-pozdravom.question.en: How does Emma end her e-mail to pani Sokolová?
a2-u6-l9.choice-s-pozdravom.question.t: Emma Sokolova xonimga yozgan xatini qanday tugatadi?

a2-u6-l9.choice-s-pozdravom.why.en: A formal e-mail ends with **S pozdravom** and your name. Maj sa and Zatiaľ are for friends.
a2-u6-l9.choice-s-pozdravom.why.t: Rasmiy elektron xat **S pozdravom** va ismingiz bilan tugaydi. Maj sa va Zatiaľ — doʻstlar uchun.

a2-u6-l9.izba-je-sice-mala.en.en: The room may be small, but it's nice.

a2-u6-l9.izba-je-sice-mala.note.en: **síce … ale** = it's true that…, but… Síce goes after the verb in the first part, and ale starts the second. **len** = only.
a2-u6-l9.izba-je-sice-mala.note.t: **síce … ale** = …boʻlsa ham, … / …-ku, lekin… Síce birinchi qismda feʼldan keyin keladi, ale esa ikkinchi qismni boshlaydi. **len** = faqat.

a2-u6-l9.fill-penzion-je-sice.en.en: The guesthouse may be expensive, but it's very nice.
a2-u6-l9.fill-penzion-je-sice.en.t: Mehmon uyi qimmat boʻlsa ham, juda chiroyli.

a2-u6-l9.fill-penzion-je-sice.why.en: **Síce** in the first part gets ready for the **ale** in the second: síce drahý, ale pekný.
a2-u6-l9.fill-penzion-je-sice.why.t: Birinchi qismdagi **síce** ikkinchi qismdagi **ale** ga tayyorlaydi: síce drahý, ale pekný.

a2-u6-l9.build-mame-sice-len.prompt.en: We've only got two rooms free, but they're big.
a2-u6-l9.build-mame-sice-len.prompt.t: Bizda faqat ikkita boʻsh xona bor, ammo ular katta.

en: After dve, the plural, and plural things take **-é**: dve **voľné** izby.
The rooms (izby, plural) are big, so **-é**: sú **veľké**.
t: dve dan keyin koʻplik keladi, koʻplikdagi narsalar esa **-é** oladi: dve **voľné** izby.
Xonalar (izby, koʻplik) katta, shuning uchun **-é**: sú **veľké**.

a2-u6-l9.choice-izbu-vam-rezervujem.ques.en: Pani Sokolová's reply. How much is a room?
a2-u6-l9.choice-izbu-vam-rezervujem.ques.t: Sokolova xonimning javobi. Bir xona qancha turadi?

en: Thirty euros a night, with breakfast.
Thirty euros a night, without breakfast.
Thirteen euros a night, with breakfast.
t: Bir kechaga oʻttiz yevro, nonushta bilan.
Bir kechaga oʻn uch yevro, nonushta bilan.

a2-u6-l9.fill-dakujem-vam-za-odpoved.en.en: Dear Mrs Sokolová, thank you for your reply.
a2-u6-l9.fill-dakujem-vam-za-odpoved.en.t: Hurmatli Sokolova xonim, javobingiz uchun rahmat.

a2-u6-l9.fill-dakujem-vam-za-odpoved.why.en: In Slovak you give thanks **to** someone: the to-whom form, **Vám**, with a capital in a letter. Vás is the object form.
a2-u6-l9.fill-dakujem-vam-za-odpoved.why.t: Slovak tilida minnatdorchilik **kimga** bildiriladi: «kimga?» shakli (datív), **Vám**, xatda bosh harf bilan. Oʻzbekchada ham «sizga rahmat». Vás — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

en: Mrs Sokolová replied that she had a room free.
Mrs Sokolová replied that she had a free room.
Mrs Sokolová replied that she has a room free.
Mrs Sokolová answered that she had a room free.
t: Sokolova xonim menga javob berib, boʻsh xonasi borligini aytdi.
Sokolova xonim menga boʻsh xonasi borligini javob berdi.
Sokolova xonim javobida boʻsh xonasi borligini yozdi.
Sokolova xonim menga javob berdi: boʻsh xonasi bor.

a2-u6-l9.choice-emma-pise-kamaratom.ques.en: Emma's e-mail to her friends. What's true?
a2-u6-l9.choice-emma-pise-kamaratom.ques.t: Emmaning doʻstlariga yozgan xati. Qaysi biri toʻgʻri?

en: They're going by train and staying three nights.
They're going by car and staying three nights.
They're going by car and staying two nights.
t: Ular poyezdda borishadi va uch kecha qolishadi.
Ular mashinada borishadi va uch kecha qolishadi.
Ular mashinada borishadi va ikki kecha qolishadi.

a2-u6-l10.osobne-udaje.note.en: **údaj** = a piece of information. On a form: meno, priezvisko, **dátum a miesto narodenia** (date and place of birth), **povolanie** (occupation), adresa.
a2-u6-l10.osobne-udaje.note.t: **údaj** = (bitta) maʼlumot. Blankada: meno (ism), priezvisko (familiya), **dátum a miesto narodenia** (tugʻilgan sana va joy), **povolanie** (kasb), adresa (manzil).

a2-u6-l10.formular.note.en: **vyplniť formulár** = to fill in a form. You know **dotazník** (a questionnaire) from A1.
a2-u6-l10.formular.note.t: **vyplniť formulár** = blankani toʻldirmoq. **dotazník** (anketa) ni A1 dan bilasiz.

a2-u6-l10.fill-vyplnte-prosim-tento.why.en: The form is the object, and formulár is a masculine thing, so it doesn't change: tento **formulár**.
a2-u6-l10.fill-vyplnte-prosim-tento.why.t: Blanka — toʻldiruvchi, formulár esa erkak jinsidagi narsa, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: tento **formulár**.

a2-u6-l10.adresa.note.en: Emma's address: **Javorová 12, 841 04 Bratislava**: the street (ulica), the number, the postcode and the town.
a2-u6-l10.adresa.note.t: Emmaning manzili: **Javorová 12, 841 04 Bratislava** — koʻcha (ulica), uy raqami, pochta indeksi va shahar.

a2-u6-l10.fill-byvam-na-javorovej.en.en: I live at number 12, Javorová Street.

a2-u6-l10.fill-byvam-na-javorovej.why.en: **Na** + “where?” takes the locative, and ulica (after c) takes **-i**: na Javorovej **ulici**.
a2-u6-l10.fill-byvam-na-javorovej.why.t: **Na** + «qayerda?» lokál talab qiladi, ulica esa (c dan keyin) **-i** oladi: na Javorovej **ulici**.

a2-u6-l10.choice-emmin-formular.question.en: Emma's form. Where was she born?

a2-u6-l10.mailova-adresa.note.en: You know **zavináč** (@) from unit 1; the dot is **bodka**: emma zavináč mail bodka sk.
a2-u6-l10.mailova-adresa.note.t: **zavináč** (@) ni 1-boʻlimdan bilasiz; nuqta esa **bodka**: emma zavináč mail bodka sk.

en: Adresa is feminine, so the question word matches it: **Aká**.
The adjective matches adresa, feminine: **mailová** adresa.
t: Adresa — ayol jinsida, shuning uchun soʻroq soʻzi unga moslashadi: **Aká**.
Sifat ayol jinsidagi adresa ga moslashadi: **mailová** adresa.

a2-u6-l10.choice-zavinac.question.en: Emma reads out her e-mail address. What is @ in Slovak?
a2-u6-l10.choice-zavinac.question.t: Emma elektron pochta manzilini aytib beryapti. Slovak tilida @ nima deyiladi?

a2-u6-l10.prihlasit-sa.note.en: **prihlásiť sa na** + the object form: Prihlásila som sa na seminár. You know **prihláška** (a registration form) from A1.
a2-u6-l10.prihlasit-sa.note.t: **prihlásiť sa na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli: Prihlásila som sa na seminár. = Seminarga yozildim. **prihláška** (roʻyxatdan oʻtish arizasi) ni A1 dan bilasiz.

a2-u6-l10.fill-chcela-by-som-sa-prihlasi.en: I'd like to sign up for the seminar on Friday.
**Prihlásiť sa na** takes the object form; seminár is a masculine thing, so it stays the same: na **seminár**. Na seminári means at the seminar.
a2-u6-l10.fill-chcela-by-som-sa-prihlasi.t: **Prihlásiť sa na** toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi; seminár — erkak jinsidagi narsa, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: na **seminár** (seminarga). Na seminári — «seminarda» degani.

a2-u6-l10.choice-emma-sa-prihlasuje.ques.en: Emma's e-mail. Why is she writing?
a2-u6-l10.choice-emma-sa-prihlasuje.ques.t: Emmaning elektron xati. U nima uchun yozyapti?

en: To sign up for the seminar.

a2-u6-l10.vazeny-pan-inzinier.en.en: Dear Sir, (to a man with an engineer's title)

a2-u6-l10.vazeny-pan-inzinier.note.en: Formal letters often use a title instead of the name: **Vážená pani inžinierka**, **Vážený pán riaditeľ**, **Vážená pani doktorka**.
a2-u6-l10.vazeny-pan-inzinier.note.t: Rasmiy xatlarda koʻpincha ism oʻrniga unvon ishlatiladi: **Vážená pani inžinierka**, **Vážený pán riaditeľ**, **Vážená pani doktorka**.

a2-u6-l10.priloha.note.en: **V prílohe posielam** formulár. = Please find the form attached (**posielať** = to send). At a meal, a príloha is a side dish!
a2-u6-l10.priloha.note.t: **V prílohe posielam** formulár. = Blankani ilovada yuboryapman (**posielať** = yubormoq). Ovqatda esa príloha — garnir!

a2-u6-l10.build-v-prilohe-posielam.promp.en: I'm sending the form as an attachment.

en: In the attachment: **v** + the locative, -a becomes **-e**: v **prílohe**.
You're the one sending it: the ja form **posielam**. Posiela is he or she sends.
t: Yuborayotgan — siz: ja shakli **posielam**. Posiela — «u yuboryapti» degani.

a2-u6-l10.build-som-z-irska-a-pracujem.p.en: Emma introduces herself in the e-mail: “I'm from Ireland and I work as an intern.”
a2-u6-l10.build-som-z-irska-a-pracujem.p.t: Emma elektron xatda oʻzini tanishtiradi: «Men Irlandiyadanman va amaliyotchi boʻlib ishlayman.»

en: Emma is a woman, so it's **stážistka**. Stážista is a man.
**Z** (from) takes the genitive: z **Írska**, as in Som z Írska.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun **stážistka**. Stážista — erkak.
**Z** (…dan) genitív talab qiladi: z **Írska**, xuddi Som z Írska dagi kabi.

a2-u6-l11.esemeska.note.en: **Napíš mi esemesku!** = Text me! **esemeskovať** = to text (informal).
a2-u6-l11.esemeska.note.t: **Napíš mi esemesku!** = Menga SMS yoz! **esemeskovať** = SMS yozmoq (soʻzlashuvda). Esemeska soʻzi SMS harflarining oʻqilishidan kelib chiqqan: es-em-es.

a2-u6-l11.fill-napis-mi-esemesku.en.en: I can't talk now. Text me!
a2-u6-l11.fill-napis-mi-esemesku.en.t: Hozir gaplasha olmayman. Menga SMS yoz!

a2-u6-l11.fill-napis-mi-esemesku.why.en: The text is what you write, the object, so -a becomes **-u**: napíš mi **esemesku**.
a2-u6-l11.fill-napis-mi-esemesku.why.t: SMS — siz yozadigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga **-u**: napíš mi **esemesku**.

a2-u6-l11.budem-meskat.note.en: **meškať** = to be late. **Prepáč, nehnevaj sa, budem meškať desať minút.** = Sorry, don't be cross, I'll be ten minutes late.
a2-u6-l11.budem-meskat.note.t: **meškať** = kechikmoq. **Prepáč, nehnevaj sa, budem meškať desať minút.** = Kechir, xafa boʻlma, oʻn daqiqa kechikaman.

a2-u6-l11.choice-prepac-budem-meskat.que.en: Emma is still on the tram, and she's meeting Lucia at five. What does she text?
a2-u6-l11.choice-prepac-budem-meskat.que.t: Emma hali tramvayda, Lusiya bilan esa soat beshda uchrashishi kerak. U nima deb yozadi?

a2-u6-l11.choice-prepac-budem-meskat.why.en: Lucia is a friend, so it's **Prepáč** (ty); Prepáčte is for vy. And from five up it's **minút**: desať minút.
a2-u6-l11.choice-prepac-budem-meskat.why.t: Lusiya — doʻst, shuning uchun **Prepáč** (ty); Prepáčte — vy uchun. Beshdan boshlab esa **minút**: desať minút.

a2-u6-l11.nestiham.en.en: I can't make it. / I'm running late.

a2-u6-l11.nestiham.note.en: **stíhať** = to keep up, to make it in time (you know **stihnúť** from A1). To move a meeting: **O tretej nestíham. Môžeme sa stretnúť o štvrtej?**
a2-u6-l11.nestiham.note.t: **stíhať** = ulgurmoq, vaqtida yetib bormoq (**stihnúť** ni A1 dan bilasiz). Uchrashuvni boshqa vaqtga koʻchirish uchun: **O tretej nestíham. Môžeme sa stretnúť o štvrtej?** = Soat uchga ulgurmayman. Soat toʻrtda uchrasha olamizmi?

a2-u6-l11.build-o-tretej-nestiham.prompt.en: I can't make it at three. Can we meet at four?
a2-u6-l11.build-o-tretej-nestiham.prompt.t: Soat uchga ulgurmayman. Soat toʻrtda uchrasha olamizmi?

en: After môžeme comes the infinitive: môžeme sa **stretnúť**.
t: môžeme dan keyin infinitív keladi: môžeme sa **stretnúť**.

a2-u6-l11.musim-zrusit-stretnutie.en.en: I have to cancel our meeting.

a2-u6-l11.musim-zrusit-stretnutie.note.en: **zrušiť** = to cancel. Give a reason with pretože: Musím zrušiť **dnešné** (today's) stretnutie, pretože mám poradu.
a2-u6-l11.musim-zrusit-stretnutie.note.t: **zrušiť** = bekor qilmoq. Sababini pretože (chunki) bilan ayting: Musím zrušiť **dnešné** (bugungi) stretnutie, pretože mám poradu.

a2-u6-l11.fill-pretoze-som-chora.en.en: Emma: “I have to cancel today's meeting because I'm ill.”
a2-u6-l11.fill-pretoze-som-chora.en.t: Emma: «Bugungi uchrashuvni bekor qilishim kerak, chunki kasalman.»

a2-u6-l11.fill-pretoze-som-chora.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the adjective ends in **-á**: som **chorá**.
a2-u6-l11.fill-pretoze-som-chora.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **-á** bilan tugaydi: som **chorá**.

a2-u6-l11.dik-za-ponuku.note.en: **dík** = thanks (informal, mostly in texts); **ponuka** = an offer. **Super nápad!** = Great idea!
a2-u6-l11.dik-za-ponuku.note.t: **dík** = rahmat (soʻzlashuvda, asosan SMSlarda); **ponuka** = taklif. **Super nápad!** = Zoʻr fikr!

a2-u6-l11.choice-ahoj-dnes-nestiham.ques.en: A text from Tomáš. What does he want?

a2-u6-l11.fill-prepac-nehnevaj-sa.en.en: Sorry, don't be cross! I'll be late.

a2-u6-l11.fill-prepac-nehnevaj-sa.why.en: To a friend, the ty form: **nehnevaj** sa. Nehnevajte sa is for vy, and hnevaj sa would mean “be cross!”.
a2-u6-l11.fill-prepac-nehnevaj-sa.why.t: Doʻstga ty shakli: **nehnevaj** sa. Nehnevajte sa — vy uchun, hnevaj sa esa «xafa boʻl!» degani boʻlardi.

a2-u6-l11.build-dik-za-ponuku.prompt.en: Thanks for the offer, great idea!

en: **Za** in a thank-you takes the object form: za **ponuku**, like Ďakujem za darček.
One idea: **nápad**. Nápady is the plural.
t: Minnatdorchilikdagi **za** toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi: za **ponuku**, xuddi Ďakujem za darček kabi.

a2-u6-l11.choice-stihas-to-o-piatej.ques.en: A text from Lucia. What is she asking?

en: Can you make it at five?
Are you going to be late?
I have to cancel the meeting because I'm ill.
I have to cancel our meeting because I'm ill.
I must cancel the meeting because I'm ill.
I need to cancel the meeting because I'm ill.
t: Uchrashuvni bekor qilishim kerak, chunki kasalman.
Uchrashuvimizni bekor qilishim kerak, chunki kasalman.
Uchrashuvni bekor qilishga majburman, chunki kasalman.
Kasal boʻlganim uchun uchrashuvni bekor qilishim kerak.

a2-u6-l11.choice-jasne-plati.question.en: Marek texts: “Kino o ôsmej?” Which answer says yes?
a2-u6-l11.choice-jasne-plati.question.t: Marek yozadi: «Kino o ôsmej?» Qaysi javob «ha» degani?

a2-u6-l12.grammar-soft-endings.title.en: d, t, n go soft: príď, vráť, zostaň
a2-u6-l12.grammar-soft-endings.title.t: d, t, n yumshaydi: príď, vráť, zostaň

en: When the stem ends in **d**, **t** or **n**, the ty form softens it to **ď**, **ť**, **ň**: prídu → **príď**, vrátia sa → **vráť sa**, zostanú → **zostaň** (zostať = to stay).
The vy and my forms keep the soft letter: príď**te**, príď**me**.
t: Oʻzak **d**, **t** yoki **n** bilan tugasa, ty shaklida u yumshoq undoshga aylanadi: **ď**, **ť**, **ň**: prídu → **príď**, vrátia sa → **vráť sa**, zostanú → **zostaň** (zostať = qolmoq).
Vy va my shakllarida ham yumshoq harf saqlanadi: príď**te**, príď**me**.

a2-u6-l12.fill-emma-prid-zajtra.en.en: Emma, come to reception at nine tomorrow!
a2-u6-l12.fill-emma-prid-zajtra.en.t: Emma, ertaga soat toʻqqizda qabulxonaga kel!

a2-u6-l12.fill-emma-prid-zajtra.why.en: Prísť → prídu: the stem ends in d, which softens: **príď**. Prídeš means you'll come.
a2-u6-l12.fill-emma-prid-zajtra.why.t: Prísť → prídu: oʻzak d bilan tugaydi, u yumshaydi: **príď**. Prídeš — «kelasan» degani.

a2-u6-l12.fill-lucia-zaplat-za-kavu.en.en: Lucia, please pay for the coffee, I'll pay for lunch.
a2-u6-l12.fill-lucia-zaplat-za-kavu.en.t: Lusiya, iltimos, qahva uchun sen toʻla, men tushlik uchun toʻlayman.

a2-u6-l12.fill-lucia-zaplat-za-kavu.why.en: Zaplatiť → zaplatia: the t softens to ť: **zaplať**. Zaplatí means he or she pays.
a2-u6-l12.fill-lucia-zaplat-za-kavu.why.t: Zaplatiť → zaplatia: t yumshab ť ga aylanadi: **zaplať**. Zaplatí — «u toʻlaydi» degani.

a2-u6-l12.fill-zostante-tu-prosim.en.en: Mr Hudák will be here in a moment. Please stay here.
a2-u6-l12.fill-zostante-tu-prosim.en.t: Janob Hudak hozir keladi. Iltimos, shu yerda qoling.

a2-u6-l12.fill-zostante-tu-prosim.why.en: Zostať → zostanú: n softens to ň, and for vy add -te: **Zostaňte**. Zostanete means you will stay; zostaň is for a friend.
a2-u6-l12.fill-zostante-tu-prosim.why.t: Zostať → zostanú: n yumshab ň boʻladi, vy uchun esa -te qoʻshiladi: **Zostaňte**. Zostanete — «qolasiz» degani; zostaň — doʻst uchun.

a2-u6-l12.build-vrat-sa-o-siestej.prompt.en: Come back at six! (to a friend)

en: Vrátia → **Vráť**: the t softens, with no ending for ty. Vráti means he or she comes back.
At six: o + the -ej form: o **šiestej**.
t: Vrátia → **Vráť**: t yumshaydi, ty uchun qoʻshimcha yoʻq. Vráti — «u qaytadi» degani.

en: If the stem ends in two consonants, the ty form adds **-i**: pošl**ú** → pošl**i**, sadn**ú** si → sadn**i** si. Then -te and -me go after the -i: pošli**te**, pošli**me**.
Sa and si stay right after the verb: **Sadni si!** **Ozvi sa!**
t: Oʻzak ikki undosh bilan tugasa, ty shakli **-i** oladi: pošl**ú** → pošl**i**, sadn**ú** si → sadn**i** si. -te va -me esa shu -i dan keyin keladi: pošli**te**, pošli**me**.
Sa va si darhol feʼldan keyin turadi: **Sadni si!** **Ozvi sa!**

a2-u6-l12.grammar-two-consonants-i.table.en: poslať = to send, sadnúť si = to sit down, ozvať sa = to get in touch, vziať si = to take, vysvetliť = to explain, navrhnúť = to suggest
a2-u6-l12.grammar-two-consonants-i.table.t: poslať = yubormoq, sadnúť si = oʻtirmoq, ozvať sa = xabar bermoq (bogʻlanmoq), vziať si = olmoq, vysvetliť = tushuntirmoq, navrhnúť = taklif qilmoq

a2-u6-l12.fill-plati-to-ozvi-sa.en.en: Is it on? Get back to me this evening.
a2-u6-l12.fill-plati-to-ozvi-sa.en.t: Kelishdikmi? Bugun kechqurun menga xabar ber.

a2-u6-l12.fill-plati-to-ozvi-sa.why.en: Ozvať sa → ozvú sa: the stem ozv- ends in two consonants, so add **-i**: **Ozvi** sa.
a2-u6-l12.fill-plati-to-ozvi-sa.why.t: Ozvať sa → ozvú sa: ozv- oʻzagi ikki undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-i** qoʻshiladi: **Ozvi** sa.

a2-u6-l12.fill-pani-kollarova-sadnite-si.en: For vy, -te goes after the -i: **sadnite** si. Sadni si is for a friend.
a2-u6-l12.fill-pani-kollarova-sadnite-si.t: Vy uchun -te shu -i dan keyin keladi: **sadnite** si. Sadni si — doʻst uchun.

a2-u6-l12.choice-posli-mi-adresu.questio.en: Lucia wants Tomáš to send her the guesthouse's address. What does she say?
a2-u6-l12.choice-posli-mi-adresu.questio.t: Lusiya Tomash oʻziga mehmon uyining manzilini yuborishini xohlaydi. U nima deydi?

a2-u6-l12.choice-posli-mi-adresu.why.en: Poslať → pošlú: the stem pošl- ends in two consonants, so add **-i**: **Pošli**. Pošle means he or she sends.
a2-u6-l12.choice-posli-mi-adresu.why.t: Poslať → pošlú: pošl- oʻzagi ikki undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-i** qoʻshiladi: **Pošli**. Pošle — «u yuboradi» degani.

en: Vysvetlíte, with a long í, means you will explain. The request is **Vysvetlite**: vysvetli + -te.
Vysvetli is for a friend; to someone you call vy, add -te: **Vysvetlite**.
t: Choʻziq í bilan vysvetlíte — «tushuntirasiz» degani. Iltimos esa **Vysvetlite**: vysvetli + -te.
Vysvetli — doʻst uchun; «siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga -te qoʻshing: **Vysvetlite**.

a2-u6-l12.choice-premysli-si-to.why.en: **Premysli** is the command: the stem premysl- ends in two consonants, so it adds -i. Premyslím means I'll think it over.
a2-u6-l12.choice-premysli-si-to.why.t: **Premysli** — buyruq: premysl- oʻzagi ikki undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun -i qoʻshiladi. Premyslím — «oʻylab koʻraman» degani.

en: Sit down and have a coffee.
Sit down and take a coffee.
Have a seat and have a coffee.
Take a seat and have a coffee.
Sit down and help yourself to a coffee.

a2-u6-l13.grammar-irregular-imperatives..en: Learn these by heart: povedz, jedz, pi, buď
a2-u6-l13.grammar-irregular-imperatives..t: Yod oling: povedz, jedz, pi, buď

en: A few common verbs have their own imperative: learn them as words. The vy and my forms add -te and -me as usual.
t: Koʻp ishlatiladigan baʼzi feʼllarning oʻz buyruq shakli bor: ularni alohida soʻz sifatida yodlang. Vy va my shakllari odatdagidek -te va -me qoʻshadi.
Iltimos, soat toʻqqizda shu yerda boʻling.

a2-u6-l13.fill-povedz-mi-kde.en.en: Tell me where the reception is.

a2-u6-l13.fill-povedz-mi-kde.why.en: Povedať has its own short command: **Povedz**. Povieš means you'll tell.
a2-u6-l13.fill-povedz-mi-kde.why.t: Povedať ning oʻz qisqa buyruq shakli bor: **Povedz**. Povieš — «aytasan» degani.

a2-u6-l13.fill-deti-umyte-si-ruky.why.en: To several people: umy + **-te** = **umyte** si ruky. Umy si is for one child.
a2-u6-l13.fill-deti-umyte-si-ruky.why.t: Bir necha kishiga: umy + **-te** = **umyte** si ruky. Umy si — bitta bola uchun.

a2-u6-l13.choice-pi-vela-caju.question.en: Lucia has a cold. What does Emma tell her?
a2-u6-l13.choice-pi-vela-caju.question.t: Lusiya shamollagan. Emma unga nima deydi?

a2-u6-l13.choice-pi-vela-caju.why.en: Piť has a short command: **pi**, with no j. Piješ just says you drink.
a2-u6-l13.choice-pi-vela-caju.why.t: Piť ning qisqa buyruq shakli bor: **pi**, j siz. Piješ esa shunchaki «ichasan» degani.

a2-u6-l13.fill-zajtra-mas-pohovor-bud.en.en: You've got an interview tomorrow. Be there at nine!
a2-u6-l13.fill-zajtra-mas-pohovor-bud.en.t: Ertaga ish suhbating bor. Soat toʻqqizda u yerda boʻl!

a2-u6-l13.fill-zajtra-mas-pohovor-bud.wh.en: Byť has its own command: **Buď**. Bude is the future, and si is now.
a2-u6-l13.fill-zajtra-mas-pohovor-bud.wh.t: Byť ning oʻz buyruq shakli bor: **Buď**. Bude — kelasi zamon, si esa hozirgi zamon.

en: Ísť has two imperatives. **Choď** sends someone away from you: Choď domov! **Poď** asks them to come with you or to you: **Poď sem!** (Come here!)
For “let's go”, only poď has a my form: **Poďme!** You know Poďte ďalej! and Choďte rovno from A1.
t: Ísť ning ikki buyruq shakli bor. **Choď** odamni sizdan uzoqqa joʻnatadi: Choď domov! (Uyga bor!) **Poď** esa siz bilan yoki sizning oldingizga kelishga chaqiradi: **Poď sem!** (Bu yoqqa kel!) Oʻzbekchadagi «bor» va «kel» kabi.
«Ketdik» maʼnosida my shakli faqat poď da bor: **Poďme!** Poďte ďalej! va Choďte rovno ni A1 dan bilasiz.

a2-u6-l13.fill-lucia-pod-sem.en.en: Lucia, come here! This is Tomáš's office.
a2-u6-l13.fill-lucia-pod-sem.en.t: Lusiya, bu yoqqa kel! Bu — Tomashning ofisi.

a2-u6-l13.fill-lucia-pod-sem.why.en: Coming towards the speaker is **poď**: Poď sem! Choď sends someone away.
a2-u6-l13.fill-lucia-pod-sem.why.t: Gapiruvchi tomon kelish — **poď**: Poď sem! Choď esa odamni uzoqqa joʻnatadi.

a2-u6-l13.fill-je-dvanast-hodin-podme.en.en: It's twelve o'clock. Let's go for lunch!

a2-u6-l13.fill-je-dvanast-hodin-podme.wh.en: **Poďme** is “let's go”, the my form of poď.

a2-u6-l13.choice-chod-prec.question.en: A cat walks into the office kitchen and wants your lunch. What do you tell it?
a2-u6-l13.choice-chod-prec.question.t: Ofis oshxonasiga mushuk kirib, tushligingizni yemoqchi. Unga nima deysiz?

a2-u6-l13.choice-chod-prec.why.en: Away from you is **choď**: Choď preč! Poď means come, with you or to you.
a2-u6-l13.choice-chod-prec.why.t: Sizdan uzoqqa — **choď**: Choď preč! Poď esa «kel» degani, siz bilan yoki siz tomon.

a2-u6-l13.build-pod-dalej-a-sadni.prompt.en: Come in and sit down. (to a friend)

en: Coming in, towards you, is **Poď** ďalej, like Poďte ďalej from A1.
To one friend: **sadni** si. Sadnite is for vy.
t: Ichkariga, siz tomon kirish — **Poď** ďalej, A1 dagi Poďte ďalej kabi.
Bitta doʻstga: **sadni** si. Sadnite — vy uchun.

a2-u6-l13.build-povedz-mu-aby.prompt.en: Tell him to call me. (to a friend)

en: To a friend (ty): **Povedz**. Povedzte is for vy.
After **aby**, the past form: aby mi **zavolal**.
t: **aby** dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli: aby mi **zavolal**.

a2-u6-l13.fill-polievka-je-horuca-jedzte.en: The soup's hot. Please eat slowly! (to the guests)
Jesť has its own command, jedz, and for vy add -te: **Jedzte**. Jete just says you eat.
a2-u6-l13.fill-polievka-je-horuca-jedzte.t: Jesť ning oʻz buyruq shakli bor — jedz, vy uchun esa -te qoʻshing: **Jedzte**. Jete esa shunchaki «yeysiz» degani.

en: To say “don't”, put **ne-** in front, written as one word: **Ne**čakaj! **Ne**meškajte! **Ne**hnevaj sa!
